segments.name: Life science applications
segments.description: Develops, manufactures and sells technologies, products and services for life science applications, sold to academic, pharmaceutical and CROs customers.
segments.evidence: The Company operates in one segment: the design, development, production and distribution of products and services that enable fundamental advances in life science applications, including research, pharmaceutical and therapy discovery, bioproduction and preclinical testing for pharmaceutical and therapy development.

revenueModel.text: Academic, government, pharmaceutical, biotechnology and CRO customers pay for instruments, consumables, software and services.
revenueModel.evidence: Our products and services are sold globally to customers ranging from renowned academic institutions and government laboratories to the world's leading pharmaceutical, biotechnology and contract research organizations ("CROs").
